baseline.description: No change: keep the current setup
baseline.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a (“USMCA”) of a forklift dust mop attachment. The product of CBP ruling N363381, as its facts describe it. The (“USMCA”) of a forklift dust mop attachment is assembled in Canada using components sourced from United States, Vietnam and Canada.

The dust mop are produced in United States. The cotton yarn and synthetic backing material are sourced from Vietnam. The mop frame and hitch system are produced in Canada. 

Final assembly in Canada: assemble the parts into the finished good.

Tariff classifications given with the product (HTSUS; the product's own codes, not verified by CBP): the (“USMCA”) of a forklift dust mop attachment (the finished good), 9603.90.8050; the dust mop (made in United States), 9603.90; the cotton yarn (made in Vietnam), 5205.12; the synthetic backing material (made in Vietnam), 5407.72; the mop frame (made in Canada), 9603.90; the hitch system (made in Canada), 8431.20.

key_factors: (b) single failing material imparting essential character
prediction.decisive_step: Production of the dust mop in the United States
prediction.reasoning: The rule for 9603.90 requires a shift from any other heading. The U.S.-origin dust mop is already classified in 9603.90 and fails the shift in Canada. As the only failing foreign material, it imparts essential character under 102.11(b).
